run_sequential_calibration: run sequential calibration pipeline on a torch model with a dataloader and dataset arguments
build_sequential_subgraphs: build torch.fx subgraphs from a model partitioned by sequential targets for calibration
cache_intermediate_activations: cache and offload intermediate activations between subgraphs to cpu to save memory
prefetch_calibration_batches: prefetch calibration batches in a background thread to overlap fetch with forward pass
disable_hooks_for_propagation: disable modifier hooks during propagation pass to capture outputs of newly compressed modules
